transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1016 Sweeney Park Court?
Yes, this is 1016 Sweeney Park Court. Two people are inside with water rising. No help is coming.
Acknowledged, water rising inside, no help coming. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Two people are here. No one can’t come to the phone.

Got it, two people here, no one can’t come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave on their own. No wheelchair or medical needs here.
Understood, no one is unable to leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
Yes, there’s water inside. We’re two people, and we need help.
I hear you’re inside with water and need help. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats. We’re stuck inside with water.
Understood, you’re stuck inside with water. Let me read that back: 2 people; water is inside. Is that right?
Yes. Two people inside. Water’s in.

Got it. Two people inside. Water’s in. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.

house_card: Two people reside; none barred from leaving. Water inside. Language: English.
